## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the lightweight mug for beverages from the table, rotate it, and set it in the center. Then hang the lightweight mug for beverages on the medium-sized rack.

Task description: The object is the blue handled cup on the left side of the table. Turn it and place it at the center of the table, then hang it on the gray rack on the right.

Success criteria: The blue cup hangs from the gray stand, horizontally near its central hanging area and clearly above the table; the right gripper is open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping an intact rim-wall section away from the cup handle, with one finger inside and one against the outside. Open slightly wider than the wall and confirm effective pad contact on both sides, leaving space for the hanging rod to enter the handle hole.
- The cup body partly obscures the handle. Use a side view to confirm its hole direction. Make needed rotation in open space to reduce sweeping collisions with tabletop objects or the rack.
- During hooking, orient the cup handle hole toward the free end of the angled bar. Make small adjustments to position and tilt while leaving clearance between the cup body and post, avoiding the outside of the handle pressing against the bar tip.
- If regrasping at the table center, set the cup bottom down stably before releasing the original grasp. Before releasing at the rack, lower slightly so the handle's inner surface rests on the rod, reducing unsupported slipping.
